page.overview:
Who is Aiueb Gnshal?

Aiueb Gnshal (The Eyes Between Worlds) is a fictional entity created by Kevin T. McKinnon and Dylan K. Sharpe for the Call of Cthulhu scenario "The Eyes Between Worlds", which was published in the Miskatonic University Library Association Monograph Strange Tales of Dread and Wonder.

Aiueb Gnshal is a mysterious Lesser Other God who has made his home in a long-lost temple in Bhutan, as well as many other temples. He appears as a formless black void with seven orb-like eyes. It is mainly worshipped by Ghouls who worship him in a defiled cult spoken of in the Cambuluc Scrolls of the wizard Lang-Fu. Looking into the eyes of this horrid being, after a disgusting and awful ritual, will allow you to see into the Court of Azathoth, in which he resides simultaneously as he does across his temples.

In the Cthulhu Mythos, it is said that the Mongolian warlord Temujin, better known as Genghis Khan, had the favour of Aiueb Gnshal.
